title: Pine bookshelf
summary: A floor bookshelf with four shelves. You cut six parts from two pine boards, attach them with screws and glue, and attach a thin back panel.
priceNote: Example US prices (November 2026). Replace them with the prices at your store.

lumber.name: Timber yard
lumber.note: Pick straight boards. Look along each edge before you buy it.

steps.title: Cut the parts
do: Put the boards on the two trestles.
Mark each cut from the cut list.

do.t: Measure each length two times before you cut.

do: Cut each part on the waste side of the line.
Write the part letter on the back face of each part.
steps.check: Make sure that you have two parts A, four parts B and one part C.
steps.why: Parts with letters are easy to find. Two measurements stop most errors.
steps.tip: Cut the two long sides first. If you make an error, you can use the board for a shelf.

steps.title: Sand the parts
do: Sand the front faces and the front edges with 120 grit.
Sand the same faces with 180 grit.
Remove the dust with a dry cloth.
steps.check: Make sure that no saw marks show on the front edges.
steps.why: Flat parts are easier to sand than a box. The finish shows each scratch.

steps.title: Drill the sides
do: Put the two sides A next to each other with the bottom ends aligned.
Mark the shelf lines at 60, 330, 600 and 881 mm from the bottom end.
Draw each line across both sides with the square.
Mark three holes 10 mm above each line, at 40, 118 and 195 mm from the back edge.
Drill a 3 mm pilot hole at each mark.
Countersink each hole on the outer face.
steps.check: Make sure that each side has 12 holes and that the holes on the two sides align.
steps.why: Holes in the two sides at the same positions make the shelves level.

steps.title: Attach the bottom shelf

warn.text: Wear safety glasses. The drill bit can throw chips into your eyes.

do: Stand side A on its bottom end.
Apply glue to one end of shelf B.
Align the bottom face of shelf B with the lowest line.
Clamp the shelf to the side.
Install three 50 mm screws through the side into the shelf.
steps.check: Make sure that the front edge of the shelf is flush with the front edge of the side.
steps.why: The glue makes the joint stiff. The screws hold it while the glue dries.
steps.tip: Drive the screws slowly. Stop when the head is flush with the face.

steps.title: Attach the top shelf

warn.text: Wear safety glasses. The drill bit can throw chips into your eyes.

do: Apply glue to one end of a second shelf B.
Align its top face with the top end of the side.
Install three 50 mm screws through the side into the shelf.
steps.check: Make sure that the top shelf is flush with the top end.

steps.title: Attach the second side

warn.text: Wear safety glasses. The drill bit can throw chips into your eyes.

do: Apply glue to the free ends of the two shelves.
Put the second side A on the shelf ends.
Align the holes with the shelf lines.
Install three screws into each shelf.
steps.check: Make sure that the frame stands flat on the floor.

steps.title: Install the middle shelves

warn.text: Wear safety glasses. The drill bit can throw chips into your eyes.

do: Apply glue to the two ends of a shelf B.
Slide the shelf between the sides to its line.
Install three screws through each side into the shelf.
Do the same steps for the last shelf.
steps.check: Make sure that each shelf is level.
steps.tip: Put a scrap block under the shelf at the line height. The block holds the shelf while you drive the screws.

steps.title: Attach the back panel

warn.text: Wear safety glasses. The drill bit can throw chips into your eyes.

do: Stand the frame upright with the back toward you.
Measure the two diagonals of the frame.
Push the top of the frame to the side until the two diagonals are equal.
Clamp the back panel C to the frame with its edges aligned.
Install 18 short screws through the panel into the sides and the shelves.
steps.check: Make sure that the two diagonals are equal within 2 mm.
steps.why: The back panel locks the frame square. Without it, the shelf can lean to one side.

steps.title: Apply the finish
do: Remove all dust with a dry cloth.
Apply the first coat to all faces.
Wait 2 hours.
Sand lightly with 240 grit.
Apply the second coat.
steps.check: Make sure that the finish is dry and smooth before you put books on the shelves.

steps.title: Attach the shelf to the wall

warn.text: Attach the shelf to the wall before you load it. A free bookshelf can fall on a child.
Do not drill above, below or beside a socket or a switch. Cables run there.
Wear safety glasses. The drill bit can throw chips into your eyes.

do: Put the shelf against the wall in its final position.
Find a stud behind the top of the shelf.
Attach the shelf bracket D to the top shelf with two screws.
Attach the wall bracket E to the stud with two 50 mm screws.
Connect the two brackets with the strap.
steps.check: Pull the top of the shelf. Make sure that the shelf does not move.
steps.why: Most furniture falls forward when a child climbs it. The strap stops this.
